no-restricted-syntax.message: Silently defaulting tradition parameter violates rule 7.
Defaulting timezone parameter to a specific zone violates rule 8.

Never default a coordinate. Make it required, or resolve it via resolveObservanceLocation() so the reference case is labelled (conventions §8, D22/D24). Matched by PARAMETER NAME, not by value: an allowlist of known literals missed 51.5074 itself.
Never default a timezone. It must travel with the coordinates it belongs to (D25). Matched by parameter name so an unlisted zone cannot slip through.
